# APYROBO — AI-Native Robotics Orchestration Framework

APYROBO is an open-source Python framework for building AI agents that control robots.
It provides hardware abstraction (mock, ROS 2, Unitree, Isaac Sim), a skill graph engine,
multi-robot coordination, natural language safety policies, and built-in observability.

The key differentiation: the same APYROBO agent code runs on any robot — change the URI,
not the code. Safety is enforced at the framework layer and cannot be bypassed by any agent.

## Quick start

```python
pip install apyrobo
```

```python
from apyrobo import Agent, MockAdapter, Robot, SkillExecutor

robot = Robot("mock://bot", MockAdapter("bot"))          # or any real hardware URI
agent = Agent(provider="rule")                           # or "openai", "anthropic", etc.
plan  = agent.plan("navigate to point A and pick up object", robot)
result = SkillExecutor(robot).execute_graph(plan)
print(result.status)  # completed
```

## Core concepts

### Hardware adapter pattern
URI-based abstraction: `mock://`, `nav2://`, `unitree://go2@host`, `isaac://host:port`.
Write once, run on any robot. MockAdapter for CI/testing, real adapters for production.

### Skill graph engine
DAG-based task composition. `agent.plan(task, robot)` returns a `SkillGraph`. The executor
handles parallel skill branches, retries, circuit breakers, and precondition/postcondition checks.

### Natural language safety policies
```python
from apyrobo.safety.nl_policy import NLPolicyParser, NLPolicyStore
store = NLPolicyStore("~/.apyrobo/policies.db")
store.add(NLPolicyParser().parse("never exceed 0.5 m/s near humans"))
violations = NLPolicyParser().check_compliance("navigate at 2 m/s", store.get_active_policies())
```
Parse plain English → store in SQLite → enforce before execution. Non-engineers write the rules.

### Multi-agent coordination
```python
from apyrobo.coordination.bus import TaskBus, MultiAgentCoordinator
bus = TaskBus()
# Register robots, then:
result = bus.dispatch("pick_object", required_capability="PICK")  # routes to best agent
bus.broadcast("emergency_stop")                                   # fans out to all agents
```

### CLI
```bash
apyrobo serve --transport stdio          # start a robot server
apyrobo policy add "never enter lab"    # add NL safety rule
apyrobo policy check --action "..."     # check compliance (exits 1 on violation)
apyrobo registry search navigation      # search skill registry
```

## Demos (clone → run → wow)

```bash
python demos/drone_survey/demo.py        # 10-drone coordinated survey
python demos/warehouse_robots/demo.py    # warehouse pick-and-pack with TaskBus
python demos/humanoid_nlp/demo.py        # NL safety policies on a humanoid
```

## Supported hardware

ROS 2 (Nav2 + MoveIt), Unitree Go2 + H1, NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Gazebo, MQTT, HTTP.
MockAdapter for testing without hardware.

## What APYROBO is NOT

- Not a replacement for ROS 2 — it orchestrates on top of ROS 2
- Not a general-purpose LLM library — it is robotics-specific
- Not a cloud service — runs entirely on-premises, no data leaves your environment
